protocol_control_dimensions.trial_and_rep_boundaries: Protocol trial/rep start, candidate and end markers have distinct identities; no universal first-force/first-LPT rule is promoted.
protocol_control_dimensions.repetitions: Protocol event/phase and metric results are per repetition; a repetition is not the containing session or set.
protocol_control_dimensions.sets_and_sessions: Session/set persistence is separate; no best-rep or across-set aggregation is silently authorized.
protocol_control_dimensions.task_conditions: CMJ domain records UNLOADED/LOADED conditions and FORCE_ONLY/LPT_ONLY/PAIRED modes; there is no canonical CMJ variant catalog.
protocol_control_dimensions.load_and_athlete_metadata: Load identity/mass, athlete/body mass, units, frame/sign, attachment/object, processing, timebase, synchronization and provenance must be declared; no default mass, load, gravity, 1RM or phase load.
protocol_control_dimensions.support_and_measurement_geometry: Foot-to-plate, bench-to-floor and bar-to-floor support paths are separate from measured channels; mixed/instrument-supported object contact changes COU.
protocol_control_dimensions.force_channels: FZ_LEFT/FZ_RIGHT are foot/plate interface channels; FZ_TOTAL is a derived bilateral plate-contact sum.
protocol_control_dimensions.lpt_channels: LPT_DISPLACEMENT is a declared attachment coordinate; native derivatives are separate typed outputs.
